title: Nasopharyngeal Microbiota in SARS-CoV-2 Positive and Negative Patients
author: Engen, Naqib, et al.
materials: There were no a priori exclusion criteria.

steps.title: Collect and store nasopharyngeal swabs
steps.instruction: Collect nasopharyngeal swabs (NPS) according to CDC guidelines using sterile synthetic‑head, plastic‑shaft swabs; place each swab into a labeled tube containing 3 mL viral transport medium (VTM, REMEL Micro Test™ M4RT®). Heat‑inactivate the tubes at 65 °C for 30 minutes, then store at 4 °C for up to nine days before further processing. Vortex each tube for 3 seconds, aliquot the VTM into 250 µL portions, and freeze the aliquots at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Place swab in 3 mL VTM tube
Vortex 3 s, aliquot 250 µL, freeze at –80 °C

steps.title: Extract nucleic acids from VTM
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen VTM aliquots, take 200 µL of each sample, and isolate viral nucleic acids and bacterial DNA using the NucleoMag Pathogen kit (Macherey‑Nagel, Duran, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Amplify 16S V4 region by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform a two‑stage PCR targeting the V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene with primer pair 515F (GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA) and 806R (GGACTACNVGGGTWTCTAAT) together with Fluidigm Access Array primers for Illumina sequencing. Include five PCR reagent‑blank negative controls. Use the PCR conditions described in reference [11].

steps.title: Sequence amplicons on Illumina MiniSeq
steps.instruction: Pool the PCR products and sequence them on an Illumina MiniSeq using a mid‑output kit with paired‑end 153 base reads.

steps.title: Merge and denoise sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Merge raw paired‑end reads with PEAR (v0.9.11). Quality‑filter and denoise the merged reads using the DADA2 algorithm within QIIME2 (v2020.8.0) to generate amplicon sequence variants (ASVs).

steps.title: Assign taxonomy and remove contaminants
steps.instruction: Classify ASVs with the QIIME2 naïve‑Bayes classifier trained on the SILVA 138 99 % OTU database. Remove contaminant ASVs identified by the decontam package using default parameters, and discard unassigned, chloroplast, and mitochondrial ASVs.

steps.title: Perform diversity and statistical analyses
steps.instruction: Rarefy the ASV table to 5,000 sequences per sample. Calculate alpha‑diversity metrics and test differences with an unpaired t‑test or Mann‑Whitney test after assessing normality with the Shapiro‑Wilk test (p < 0.05). Evaluate beta‑diversity using PERMANOVA with 9,999 permutations and Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction; visualize results with principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) based on Bray‑Curtis distances in QIIME2.

steps.title: Identify differential taxa
steps.instruction: Run random‑forest models (1,023 runs) with the Boruta algorithm in R to rank important taxa. Perform ANCOM to detect differentially abundant taxa, and conduct DESeq2 differential abundance analysis to obtain q‑values.
